description: Get full details for a single device (asset) in the authenticated company by its path name, including policy assignment, custom data, tags, hardware specifications and last known location. Its "lastSync" is the portal's "Last sync" (last contact); "syncedAt" is only the last status report. managedDevice.policyVersion is the current version of the device's policy, the number the portal and policy reads show; whether the device applied it is diagnose's (area policy_sync) to say. Returns a tool error if no device with that id exists in this company.

assetId.description: The asset's path name - the unique identifier returned by search_devices/get_device as "pathName".

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

name: get_device
title: Get device
